notes: AUTHORED, not captured: HDX HAPI requires a user-generated app identifier (an unauthenticated probe returned HTTP 403 {"error":"Invalid app identifier"}). The three files follow the response schemas of the public OpenAPI document (https://hapi.humdata.org/openapi.json, API 0.9.15: HapiGenericResponse[IdpsResponse], [HumanitarianNeedsResponse], [FoodSecurityResponse]) for the exact queries the adapter sends (admin_level=0; INN + Intersectoral; IPC 3+ current). Field conventions that the schema leaves open (empty-string category for totals, sector code 'Intersectoral', DTM operation / reporting-round layout) were checked against the first rows of the public 'HDX HAPI' CSV exports on data.humdata.org. ALL POPULATION FIGURES ARE ILLUSTRATIVE round numbers of a realistic order of magnitude for about 25 crisis countries and several reference periods – they are NOT real statistics (IOM DTM figures in particular may not be redistributed). resource_hdx_id values are real ids of the corresponding HDX resources where known and zero-padded placeholders otherwise. The malformed variants were authored by hand.
